proof: Normalize cube side to1 with A=(0,0,0), B=(1,0,0), C=(1,1,0), D=(0,1,0), E=(0,0,1), F=(1,0,1), G=(1,1,1), H=(0,1,1). J=(1,0,1/2), I=(0,1,1/2). Edges EJ=(1,0,-1/2) and EI=(0,1,-1/2) have squared norms5/4, dot product1/4, so the cross-section is a non-square rhombus. Its area squared is (5/4)^2-(1/4)^2=3/2. Unit face area1, hence R^2=3/2, unique choice C. D=25/16 results from treating the rhombus as a square and squaring its side-based area. Coloring does not add a right-angle or length condition; midpoints, gray section, all original labels remain frozen.
